correctness.rationale: PASS: The defining divisor coefficients for prime p yield P_p=S_p²+pX^(p-1), monic degree 2p-2, P_p(1)=p(p+1), and reduction P_p(X)=(X-1)^(2p-2) mod p; translating by 1 gives Eisenstein for every prime including 2. For odd p the algebraic Q identity factors (1+X²)H_p(X²) with H_p(Y)=S_p(Y)²+pY^((p-1)/2)T_p(Y), likewise Eisenstein at p. For p≡3 mod4, H_p(0)=1 and H_p(-1)=1-p², yielding a negative real algebraic root α; H_p irreducible implies Q(α)⊂R and α not a square there, so adjoining sqrt(α) doubles the degree to 4p-4 and forces H_p(X²) irreducible. Independent exact identities, shifted Eisenstein coefficient checks and symbolic rational polynomial factorization checked p=2,3,5,7,11.
